title: Frozen-energy relative Class-II structural reduction
statement: For the hash-pinned A1 production Gaussian, fixed positive rho floor, positive production Q_II, exact/dealiased products, and the declared common real-even scalar spectral scope, the A9 frozen-shell variable is fixed with new-shell trace Gamma_j while the coefficient commutator uses Gamma_le_j. The retained raw energy has an exact reduction whose sharp cost-free strict-dyadic fraction is theta=1. The complete covariance-normal expression has a zero-frozen negative plane-wave trace direction, forcing every cutoff-uniform relative theorem to use a strictly positive entropy coefficient. The shell sum differs from the actual A7 endpoint by an exact positive past-energy term, and a sharp rectangular-cube filtration realises independent innovations with uniform L4 stability. If both a quantitative action-recovery bound and the stabilised relative log-Laplace estimate hold with the declared budgets, an explicit conditional composition theorem yields the A7 Nelson bound.
scope: PROVED-STRUCTURAL-REDUCTION@FIXED-FLOOR-FINITE-CUTOFF on L=16 for the A1 production covariance, three complex components in the six-real convention, rho_regularizer=1e-12, eta_shell=0, positive production Q_II, exact/dealiased products, and the A7/A9 common real-even scalar spectral scope. The Gamma_j frozen convention, A6/A7 covariance factor, B/DB bounds, strict-dyadic raw sharpness, plane-wave trace defect, positive-entropy necessity, triad budget, exact multiscale action mismatch, sharp rectangular-cube filtration, and two-antecedent conditional Nelson-composition implication are closed. A production-valid action-recovery bound and the all-field stabilised relative log-Laplace estimate are open.
falsifier: A cumulative Gamma_le_j trace substituted for Gamma_j in the A9 frozen determinant; omission or duplication of the load-bearing complex-covariance factor two; a wrong sign or factor in R_j^theta; failure of Q_II positivity, beta_B or beta_1; a strict-dyadic family whose raw loss ratio does not tend to one; nonzero Class-II currents or nonnegative complete commutator on the registered common-phase plane wave; failure of the finite plane-wave slope to approach the A6 coefficient; alpha_c=0 uniform control; failure of sum_j(Q_fr+C)=V_J+E_J or the sign E_J>=0; failure of sharp-cube block independence or its uniform L4 projection bound; a wrong triad discriminant or two-antecedent conditional composition budget; an authority hash, PDF QA, non-importing, assertion-count, or cross-route failure falsifies the pinned reduction.

reproduction.expected: PASS: primary (47/47); PASS: independent (34/34); ASSERTS: 101/101; A10-CLASSII-RELATIVE-STRUCTURAL-REDUCTION-INTEGRATED-PASS; exit 0.

no_overclaim: This claim does not prove a cutoff-uniform upper form bound for the positive past-energy mismatch, the all-field stabilised relative log-Laplace or form bound, the self-coupled A7 Nelson estimate, an interacting full three-component Gibbs measure, density or partition convergence, tightness, an optimal positive-budget global theta, rho-floor removal, smooth-overlap filtration independence, asymmetric-regulator universality, infinite volume, phase transition, BCC existence or selection, T6, or T7. The conditional Nelson theorem is an implication with two open antecedents.
next_action: First prove A10-CLASSII-MULTISCALE-ACTION-DECOMPOSITION by a cutoff-uniform upper form bound on E_J=sum_j q_(B(phi_(j-1)))(D phi_(j-1)) or by a true-increment determinant theorem. Then prove A10-CLASSII-STABILISED-RELATIVE-LOG-LAPLACE while retaining the endpoint self-coupled square or allocating the production sextic through the closed sharp rectangular-cube filtration. Neither gate alone yields A7.
notes: T4 PROVED-STRUCTURAL-REDUCTION. Primary 47/47, non-importing independent 34/34, and integrated 101/101 pass. Pre-freeze adversarial review repaired a shared factor-two error in the finite plane-wave covariance; both routes now implement the pinned A6/A7 complex-to-six-real normalization and regress the finite slope against the unchanged analytic coefficient.
